title: CopiedPlaceholders
description: Copied placeholders are emailed the final document once it has been completed by all recipients.

preassigned_recipient_name.description: In some cases, it may be necessary to pre-fill the name and email for a placeholder because it will always be the same person for all documents created from this template. This sets the name.

preassigned_recipient_email.description: In some cases, it may be necessary to pre-fill the name and email for a placeholder because it will always be the same person for all documents created from this template. This sets the email.
